en: Vintage divided card showing a large open square with horse-drawn carts, a long public building and a distant church spire. The image is captioned in German "Der Hermannsplatz" with a greeting "Gruss aus Hermannstadt." Publisher credit reads "Jos. Drotleff Hermannstadt." The address side bears the Hungarian heading "Levelező-Lap" and is addressed to Herrn Prof. Julius Kootz in Mühlbach (Szász-Sebes), with a Hungarian stamp and a Dec. 31, 1898 postmark.
